title: Rice, potatoes and mussels

---
## Ingredients
- 280 g of rice
- 800 g of mussels
- 400 g of tomato pulp
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Clean the mussels, collect them in a saucepan, cover and let them open over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, stirring them.
2. Shell them and filter the liquid formed in the container.
3. Peel the garlic and let it wilt in a pan with the oil; after 3 minutes remove it, pour in the tomato pulp, moisten it with the mussel liquid and cook for 30 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
4. Meanwhile cook the rice in boiling salted water, drain it, add it to the tomato sauce, add the mussels, mix and serve.
